zh: 揀選七人辦理供給的事

p.src: 1  Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

ja: さて、そのころ、弟子の数が増えるにつれて、ギリシャ語を話すユダヤ人たち から、ヘブル語を話すユダヤ人たちに対する苦情が出ました。日々の配給で、彼らのやもめたちがないがしろにされていたからです。
zh: 那時，門徒增多，有說希臘話的猶太人向希伯來人發怨言，因為在天天的供給上忽略了他們的寡婦。
en: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
u.src: 1  Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

ja: 6:1 ギリシャ語を話すユダヤ人たちは、ヘブル人の子孫でありながら、ギリシャ語とギリシャ文化を用いていた。
en: 6:1 The Hellenists used Greek language and culture, even though they were also of Hebrew descent.

p.src: 2  The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

ja: そこで十二人は弟子全体を呼び集めて言いました。「私たちが神の言葉を後回しにして、食事の世話をするのは適切ではありません。
zh: 十二使徒叫眾門徒來，對他們說：「我們撇下上帝的道去管理飯食，原是不合宜的。
en: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
u.src: 2  The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

p.src: 3  Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

ja: ですから兄弟たち、あなたがたの中から、評判が良く、聖霊と知恵に満ちた人を七人選びなさい。この仕事を彼らに任せることにします。
zh: 所以弟兄們，當從你們中間選出七個有好名聲、被聖靈充滿、智慧充足的人，我們就派他們管理這事。
en: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
u.src: 3  Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

p.src: 4  But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

ja: 私たちは祈りと、言葉に仕える務めに専念します。」
zh: 但我們要專心以祈禱、傳道為事。」
en: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
u.src: 4  But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

p.src: 5  These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

ja: この提案は一同を喜ばせました。そこで彼らは、信仰と聖霊に満ちた人ステファノ、またピリポ、プロコロ、ニカノル、ティモン、パルメナ、アンティオキアの改宗者ニコラオを選び、
zh: 大眾都喜悅這話，就揀選了司提反，乃是大有信心、聖靈充滿的人，又揀選腓利、伯羅哥羅、尼迦挪、提門、巴米拿，並進猶太教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
en: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
u.src: 5  These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

p.src: 6  whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

ja: 使徒たちの前に立たせました。使徒たちは祈ってから、彼らの上に手を置きました。
zh: 叫他們站在使徒面前。使徒禱告了，就按手在他們頭上。
en: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
u.src: 6  whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

p.src: 7  The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

ja: 神の言葉はますます広まり、エルサレムでは弟子の数が大いに増えました。また、非常に多くの祭司たちが信仰に従うようになりました。
zh: 上帝的道興旺起來；在耶路撒冷門徒數目加增的甚多，也有許多祭司信從了這道。
en: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
u.src: 7  The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

p.src: 8  Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

ja: さて、ステファノは信仰と力に満ち、民の間で大きな不思議としるしを行っていました。
zh: 司提反滿得恩惠、能力，在民間行了大奇事和神蹟。
en: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
u.src: 8  Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

p.src: 9  But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

ja: ところが、「解放奴隷の会堂」と呼ばれる会堂に属する人々の一部と、キレネ人、アレクサンドリア人、キリキアやアジア出身の人々が立ち上がり、ステファノと議論しました。
zh: 當時有稱利百地拿會堂的幾個人，並有古利奈、亞歷山大、基利家、亞細亞各處會堂的幾個人，都起來和司提反辯論。
en: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
u.src: 9  But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

p.src: 10  They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

ja: しかし、彼が語る知恵と霊に対抗することができませんでした。
zh: 司提反是以智慧和聖靈說話，眾人敵擋不住，
en: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
u.src: 10  They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

p.src: 11  Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

ja: そこで彼らは人々をそそのかし、「われわれは、彼がモーセと神を冒瀆する言葉を語るのを聞いた」と言わせました。
zh: 就買出人來說：「我們聽見他說謗讟摩西和上帝的話。」
en: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
u.src: 11  Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

p.src: 12  They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

ja: また、民や長老たち、律法学者たちを扇動し、ステファノを襲って捕らえ、最高法院へ連れて行きました。
zh: 他們又聳動了百姓、長老，並文士，就忽然來捉拿他，把他帶到公會去，
en: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
u.src: 12  They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

p.src: 13  and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

ja: そして偽りの証人たちを立てました。彼らは言いました。「この男は、この聖なる場所と律法を冒瀆する言葉を語ってやみません。
zh: 設下假見證，說：「這個人說話，不住地糟踐聖所和律法。
en: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
u.src: 13  and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

p.src: 14  For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

ja: あのナザレのイエスがこの場所を壊し、モーセがわれわれに伝えた慣習を変えると、彼が言うのを聞いたからです。」
zh: 我們曾聽見他說，這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規條。」
en: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
u.src: 14  For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

p.src: 15  All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

ja: 最高法院に座っていた者たちが皆、ステファノをじっと見つめると、その顔は天使の顔のように見えました。
zh: 在公會裏坐着的人都定睛看他，見他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
en: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
u.src: 15  All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
